title: WGPU Custom Effects Conformance Harness Follow-on v1
problem: The CustomV1, CustomV2, and CustomV3 WGPU conformance tests duplicated the same Rgba8Unorm final-render readback helpers already owned by the shared integration-test support module. The duplication made custom-effect evidence harder to audit without adding behavior coverage.

repro.summary: CustomV1/V2/V3 WGPU conformance should render and sample through shared test support while preserving ABI registration, image registration, source, budget, and perf assertions.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test effect_custom_v1_conformance --test effect_custom_v2_conformance --test effect_custom_v3_conformance -j 1

gates.name: custom-effects-conformance
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test effect_custom_v1_conformance --test effect_custom_v2_conformance --test effect_custom_v3_conformance -j 1

continue_policy.notes: The named custom-effect conformance tests migrated successfully. Remaining conformance families should be handled in separate narrow follow-ons.
